desc.ian_image_library:title: Menticirrhus saxatilis (Northern Kingfish)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: The northern kingfish or northern kingcroaker, is a species of marine fish in the family Sciaenidae (commonly known as the "drum" or "croaker" family). It lives in the shallow coastal waters of the western Atlantic Ocean and Gulf of Mexico.
